title: Sharp Concave-Function Transfer for Lee-Type Schatten Norm Inequalities
summary: We compare the sharp constants in Lee-type Schatten norm inequalities for finite families of complex matrices with the corresponding constants obtained after applying an arbitrary nonnegative concave function to the relevant absolute values. We prove that the nonlinear problem has exactly the same best constant as the underlying linear problem for every finite matrix dimension, every number of summands, and every Schatten exponent, including the operator-norm endpoint.
